    Completamente certo. � definitivamente a maior cidade do Tibia. A  id�ia original, a "primeira fa�sca", derivou da mente de Knightmare que  sempre quis criar uma cidade realmente grande, uma cidade rodeada por  uma fortifica��o. Cada um de  n�s tamb�m projetou certos quarters (quarteir�es). Dens foi  definitivamente o principal mapper de Yalahar, que fez a maior parte da  cidade, como por exemplo, o lindo centro da cidade e o destru�do  alchemist quarter com uma grande cratera. Tudo depende do trabalho em  equipe!  
      
    Falando um pouco mais sobre voc�, como e quando voc� se juntou a CipSoft?  
      
    Estou perto dos meus cinco anos de anivers�rio hoje :). Eu entrei  na CipSoft em Abril de 2004, quando a companhia ainda era muito pequena  - Acho que fui o empregado n�mero sete ou algo assim. Voltando naqueles  dias, eu ainda era gamemaster e jogava Tibia h� muitos anos, comecei em  1999, mas pelo alto custo do tr�fico da internet eu n�o podia jogar. Em  2001, quando come�ou a se tornar popular os pre�os fixos, eu tentei  novamente e consegui me dedicar. De jogador "normal", passei a ser  counsellor, gamemaster e finalmente senior gamemaster, que foi tamb�m o  momento que vim para a CipSoft. Na realidade fui contratada como  support member, respondendo in�meros emails, treinando counsellors,  gamemasters e assim testemunhei o nascimento de muitas coisas, como o  sistema de tutor e as primeiras regras de namelock. Ao longo dos meses  eu percebi que eu ainda preferia fazer algo criativo, ent�o em  Fevereiro de 2005 abriu um espa�o na equipe de conte�do (nessa �poca o  time era constitu�do por Jan e Knightmare) e eu ca� dentro. Desde ent�o  eu tenho trabalho na equipe de conte�do, desde 2006 como l�der do time,  e ainda aprecio muito, embora muitas coisas mudaram no decorrer dos  anos.  
    Eu sei que muitos de voc�s est�o falando bastante sobre "o antigo  Tibia", e eu entendo que muitos de voc�s gostariam de t�-lo novamente,  apesar de todos os seus problemas. De qualquer forma, n�o apenas o jogo  mudou, mas tamb�m a comunidade que joga, ent�o d�vido que seria  poss�vel recriar a atmosfera que t�nhamos antigamente. Para aqueles que  sentem saudades dos velhos tempos, vamos guardar no cora��o as  mem�rias, mas tamb�m saudar as mudan�as positivas que ocorreram.

Quando olhamos para o Tibia hoje � dif�cil imaginar o que voc�s  est�o preparando para o pr�ximo update de ver�o. H� tantas cidades e  temas! No que a equipe est� trabalhando agora?  
      
    Bem, o que posso lhe dizer � que n�o haver� nenhuma grande cidade  ou novos temas para este update de ver�o. N�o � uma surpresa eu acho,  j� que adicionamos uma no �ltimo update. Apesar disso, haver� novas �reas, dungeons, quests e eventos que  estamos trabalhando no momento. N�o, n�s n�o estamos reformulando  Venore! E nenhuma �rea "grega", apesar da Medusa, desculpe. No entanto,  algumas das hist�rias contadas no �ltimo update ser�o continuadas e  teremos alguns novos contos, desafios e outras novidades. Tamb�m vamos  aprimorar a atual situa��o dos bosses e fazer outra an�lise de locais  de ca�a. Estou especialmente ansiosa para uma certa novidade, no  entanto, eu... uhm... n�o posso revelar nada ainda :) ... mas tenho  certeza que voc�s v�o gostar tamb�m!  
      
    Pode nos dar apenas uma dica dessa novidade super secreta em que voc�s est�o trabalhando?  
      
    Acredito que no momento � muito cedo para dar qualquer sugest�o  concreta, pois quando temos uma novidade sendo implementada, v�rios  departamentos da CipSoft t�m de trabalhar juntos em algumas partes do  processo. Isso significa tamb�m, que se houver alguma complica��o no  in�cio do processo, como um atraso devido a uma mudan�a urgente de  prioridades, atrasa tamb�m nossa equipe de conte�do. Assim estamos  sempre cuidando para n�o levantar muito esperan�a e expectativa entre  os nossos jogadores at� que possamos realmente dizer com seguran�a como  e quando uma novidade ser� implementada. No entanto, posso lhe dizer  uma coisa: para o pr�ximo update estamos escolhendo algumas sugest�es  do f�rum de propostas que consideramos promissoras, �teis ou  simplesmente divertidas. Se tudo ocorrer bem, vai haver algumas  surpresas muito legais nesse ver�o. Desculpe, mas isso � tudo que posso  dizer sobre esse assunto agora. :)

				Hello Chayenne, its a pleasure to talk to you. Would you like to introduce yourself to the readers?
  
   Hello everyone on Portal Tibia, nice to talk to you today! For those who haven't heard of me, I'm the team leader of the content department at CipSoft. 'Content' means that we are creating and designing for example new areas, stories, npcs or monsters without changing game features. We content people are no programmers or technicians, just so you know that I'm the wrong person to ask about lags, kicks or botters. :)
   
  Can you talk a bit more of you? Your age, your hobbys and what you did before join CipSoft?
  I'm 28 years old now - argh! where did the last 10 years go?? - and my free time is usually stuffed with activities. I guess I just love doing too many things to ever be able to fit them into a 24-hour-day. The couch-potato-side of me loves playing console or computer games, board games, reading novels and comics and watching movies. I'm especially fond of scifi, fantasy and horror. The slightly more action-oriented side of me prefers doing all sorts of sports at the gym or outdoors, riding, travelling and partying with friends. I love animals and also have pets - five rat girls which keep me busy in the evenings when they may roam freely around the flat and I need to pay close attention as they never keep out of mischief :) Music has also always played a very important role in my life. I play some instruments since I was little and always loved to sing. In fact before I joined CipSoft I was about to study music and english, because I wanted to do something different after having finished school and job training. My original job training was in the computer industry, so I learnt some programming, assembling computers, building up networks and all that stuff... but well, fate has led me elsewhere :)
  
   How is the job of a content manager? Where does the inspiration come from? I heard something about coffee machines and Life Fluids, but I'm not so sure.
  
   As a team leader for the content my main job is to organise the content production for Tibia, TibiaME and soon also Fiction Fighters. Right now, most of my time is devoted to Tibia, which I especially enjoy because I can bring many of my ideas to life there myself. For example, the whole Vengoth area and vampire story introduced with the last update was somewhat 'my baby' and I really loved creating it. A few players also personally gave me some positive feedback about it which really is the best reward you can hope for as a content designer - and which are also the moments when I love my job most. :) Sometimes I'm so busy with creating schedules, organising stuff and attending meetings though that there's not much time left to really write a story or a long questline and I have to leave that part to the other team members. But well, that's all part of the job.
   
   Talking about inspiration, nah, I don't need coffee nor life fluids for that. I think on the one hand you just have to go through the world with open eyes to get many ideas and fuel your creativity. On the other hand, I also often play games, read books and watch movies, so of course I'm influenced by other stories and pictures which I enjoyed. Vengoth, for example, was slightly inspired by the great Castlevania series - the NPC Julius paying obvious homage to that. Unfortunately our creativity is restrained by several technical restrictions. Trying to create emotions similar to movies, books or even some other games can be a very difficult task. We're trying our best though :)
   
   I guess Yalahar was one of the most complex citys built until now, am I wrong? Where does the main idea came from?
   
   Completely right. It's definitely the biggest city in Tibia. The original idea, the basic spark, derived from the mind of Knightmare who had always wanted to create a really large, round city in state of siege, a bit like the famous historical sieges. The city centre would be the stronghold of the 'good' and the outside ring would form the attack front of the 'evil'. However, again, technical restrictions sometimes prevent us from implementing certain concepts, so the basic idea was changed and developed further by Dens Larika, Knightmare and me until it eventually became what Yalahar is now. Each of us also designed certain quarters. Dens was definitely the main 'map artist' for Yalahar who contributed most to the city and made for example the beautiful city core and the destroyed alchemist quarter with the large crater. So it's all about teamwork!
   
   Talking a bit more about you, how and when did you join to the CipSoft team?
   
   I'm close to my five-year-anniversary now :) I joined CipSoft in April 2004 when the company was still really small - I think I was employee number seven or something. Back in those days I was still a gamemaster and had played Tibia for many years, first tried it out in 1999 but due to the high internet traffic cost couldn't afford really playing it. In 2001, when flatrates started to become popular, I gave it another try and really got somewhat addicted to it. From being a 'normal' player I went to being a counsellor, a gamemaster and eventually even a senior gamemaster, which was also the time when I came to CipSoft. Actually I was hired as a support member, so I answered countless emails, coached counsellors and gamemasters and witnessed the birth of many things, such as the tutor system or first namelock rules. Over the course of the months I realised though that I'd rather do something creative, so when in February 2005 there was an open space in the content team (which by that time consisted of Jan and Knightmare) I gladly slipped in. Ever since then I've been working in the content team, since 2006 as a team leader, and still enjoy it although everything has changed so much over the past years. I still know what you're talking about when some of you mention 'the old Tibia' and I also understand very well why some of you would love to have it back despite all its problems. However, not only the game has changed but also the community who plays it, so I doubt it would be possible to recreate the atmosphere we had back then even if we turned the server time back to the freshly arrived millenium. So for those of you who miss the old days, let's cherish the memories but also welcome the positive changes made to the game in the meantime. By now, they do have their right to exist I think. But now I'm blabbering :)
   
   When you look at Tibia today it is difficult to imagine what you are preperaing to the next summer update. There are already so many citys and themes! What is the content team working on right now?
   
   Well, what I can already tell you is that there will be no big city or new theme for this summer's update. Not a surprise I think, since we just had one. Nevertheless there will be new areas, dungeons, quests and events which we are working on right now. No, we are not revamping Venore! And no greek area despite the Medusa, sorry. However, some of the stories told with the last update will be continued and some new tales, challenges and features will find their way into the game. We're also going to improve the current boss monster situation and do another hunting ground analysis. I'm especially looking forward to one certain feature however, which I.... uhm... mustn't tell yet :) ... which I'm sure you'll like too!
  
  Can you give us just a tip of the top secret feature you are working on?
   
   Chayenne: "I fear at the moment it is still too early to give any concrete hints, because when having a new feature implemented, several departments at CipSoft have to work together in some sort of chain process. That also means if there are any complications early in that chain, like a delay due to an urgent shift of priorities, it also delays our content work related to that feature. Thus we're always careful not to raise too much hope and expectations among our players until we can really say for sure how and when a feature is going to be implemented. However, I can tell you this: for the next update we've chosen a few features from the proposal board which we consider to be promising, helpful or simply fun. If everything goes well, there will be some really nice surprises this summer. Sorry, but that's all I can tell you about that topic now :)
  
  (IMG:http://www.portaltibia.com.br/uploads/1f4cab8fc116705276ecbd528725eda2.jpg) 

  
  What about the Beholder language? People are dying to understand it. What you can say about it?
   114514519485611451908304576512282177 :) 6612527570584 xD
  
  To finish the interview, I will give you sentences and words to you to
   answer with the first thing that comes in your mind.
   
   Ready? Go!
   
   - Favorite vocation
   - Sorcerer
   
   - Favorite Tibian City
   - Ab'Dendriel (for nostalgic reasons)
   
   - A nice movie
   - Stardust
   
   - A good music
   - Disturbed
   
   - Favorite Sport
   - Yoga, Taekwondo, Horseback riding
   
   - Instruments you play
   - Piano, Violin, my Guitar Hero Guitar xD
   
   - The Demon Oak Complete Spoil
   - 42!
   
   - Languages you speak
   - German, English, French and fragments of Japanese, Swedish, Orcish and Chakoya :)
   
   - A place to spend vacation
   - Tropical island with an empty beach sounds great to me!
   
   - Favorite emoticon :D
   - xD ^^;
   
   - Release date of Fiction Fighters
   - When it's done :) Not 100% set yet, honestly.
   
 That was a really amazing interview, Chayenne. Thank you for sharing a bit of your world with us.
   - Sure! Thanks for having me, I had fun answering your questions :) Have a good time and take care!
